top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs ligand-controlled Pd-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig), the clearest general method on the slate, with clean attribution, thirty years of routine use in drug discovery and process chemistry, and no maturity doubt, with base editing credited to Liu for the evolved DNA-acting deaminase and double-strand-break-free base conversion. Next come P001 and P002, which carry the same base-editing science but without the C-N coupling part: P001 adds PROTAC degradation, a designed-molecule achievement whose attribution is less settled, and P002 credits Komor and Gaudelli, who did the decisive evolved-deaminase chemistry, but is a single-achievement prize. P004 follows because dye-sensitized cells are a real but superseded technology. No award ranks last since several mature achievements are available.
